item.description:
# Weft 1.0.16
- Run Company Sign-in as a separate Weft service and wait for it before starting Pi. Relay and browser-driver errors now appear in its own logs. - Reuse a verified company sign-in relay already running on port 9090 without treating it as a Pi port conflict or stopping the external relay. - Repair damaged cached sign-in browser drivers from Weft, preserving a backup before the helper downloads a replacement. - Make company sign-in repair available in the main project view, Activity, and onboarding instead of silently retrying startup.
